description: Tables of the game's sound driver. All rows are positional: the row number is the id that the game, scripts and saves use, so never reorder. reverb_depths and layer_channels: the driver's reverb depth and channel tables; files: the sound bank files on the disc (bank, sector, size); effects: the sound effects (row = sound effect id - the base id; bank, program, note, volume); xa_lines: the streamed XA voice lines (row = XA line id; file, sector, length, group). Every effects and xa_lines row carries a readable "name", which the loader does not read: an effect row has the name of its sound in sounds/sounds.json (row 0, the base id, is "none"); an XA line has its sounds.json name, else <place>_<scene>_line_<n> (the n-th entry of the voice table of that map scene, which says what the line is), else xa<container>_group<channel group>_line<n> (only its place on the disc: no data of the game names it).
